locator.title: Грудное вскармливание без стресса: что нужно знать маме
locator.lead: Развеиваем мифы о грудном вскармливании и знакомим с комплексом Фемибион®
locator.caption: Помните, чем чаще вы кормите грудью, тем больше молока вырабатывается. Поэтому кормите малыша по требованию — обычно это 8–12 раз в день. Не нужно придерживаться строгого графика, просто ориентируйтесь на ребенка [5]

current_heading.text: Миф 2. Если пить много чая с молоком — будет больше грудного молока

nearest_text_before.text: Еще гормон активнее выделяется ночью, поэтому кормление грудью в это время особенно полезно для лактации. Также важно поддерживать водный баланс [2]. Выпивайте не менее двух литров чистой воды, это примерно восемь стаканов в день.

nearest_text_after.text: Миф 3. У кормящей мамы должна быть строгая диета, чтобы точно исключить любые аллергены

image_reading: A still-life arrangement shows one central glass filled with milk, one capped milk bottle at left, plates of rectangular biscuits, a second bottle near the upper edge, and a folded striped cloth on a wooden tabletop.
All products and tableware are stationary; no pouring, hand, visible liquid flow, or other source-grounded object action is present.
The overlapping tabletop boards, foreground plate, central glass, background plate and bottle create readable depth for a restrained camera move.
analysis.article_context: The body image supports the section’s distinction between milk-based drinks and the actual drivers of lactation, while visually reinforcing ordinary hydration and nourishment rather than presenting milk as a remedy.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Present milk as an ordinary food and drink within a calm hydration context, without implying that tea or milk itself increases lactation.
structured_intent.initial_state: A stationary tabletop still life with a filled glass centered among milk bottles, biscuit plates and a folded cloth.
structured_intent.primary_action: A bounded forward move toward the central glass reveals source-grounded parallax across the tabletop arrangement.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The central glass appears modestly larger while remaining fully visible, and foreground and background objects show a clear parallax shift without changing their world-space arrangement.
structured_intent.geometry_invariant: Every bottle, glass, plate, biscuit and cloth remains fixed on its supporting surface with rigid shapes and unchanged liquid levels.
structured_intent.identity_invariant: Preserve the same central glass, two visible bottles, plates, biscuits and single striped cloth; no item appears, disappears or changes identity.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The scene remains a calm, ordinary food-and-hydration still life and does not depict milk as causing increased lactation.
structured_intent.feasibility_assessment: The image clearly proves a stationary tabletop arrangement and several depth layers, but shows no hand, pouring direction, active contact or mechanics that would justify object action. A source-grounded camera move is feasible.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, begin the camera push-in immediately and continue at an even moderate pace toward the central glass. Use the foreground plate, left bottle and background dishes to produce clear but restrained parallax; keep the shot continuous and all objects perfectly stationary in world space. Ease gently near the end when the central glass is observably larger but still fully contained in the composition.
models.positive_prompt: The camera makes a smooth bounded push-in toward the central glass, with source-grounded parallax shifting the foreground plate and left bottle by about 5–8% of the frame while every rigid object keeps its exact shape and placement on the table. By the final frames the glass is modestly larger and remains fully visible, with the same bottles, biscuits, plates, cloth, and milk levels unchanged.
